scope: Public, open-source projects relevant to building, operating, evaluating, or deploying AI agents.
ranking: Balanced score: 55% normalized popularity (stars/forks/watchers), 25% recency, 10% maintenance, 10% relevance. Scores are comparative within this dataset, not a universal quality judgment.
license_rule: Included only projects with license metadata returned by the forge API. License values are reported as provided; verify before commercial use.
discovery: GitHub public repository search, category/topic and capability queries; previous GitLab/Codeberg queries were retained in the source trace but did not yield license-qualified rows.
